children: -- Dividend 15 Split Corp. (The "Company") declares its monthly distribution of $0.10000 for each Class A share ($1.20 annualized) and $0.05833 for each Preferred share ($0.700 annually). Distributions are payable October 9, 2026 to shareholders on record as at September 30, 2026.

Since inception Class A shareholders have received a total of $29.60 per share and Preferred shareholders have received a total of $12.28 per share inclusive of this distribution, for a combined total of $41.88.

Dividend 15 invests primarily in a high quality portfolio of leading Canadian dividend-yielding stocks as follows: Bank of Montreal, Bank of Nova Scotia, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Royal Bank of Canada, Toronto-Dominion Bank, National Bank of Canada, BCE Inc., Manulife Financial, Enbridge, Sun Life Financial, TELUS Corporation, Thomson Reuters Corporation, TransAlta Corporation, TC Energy Corporation.

title: Dividend 15 Split Corp. Monthly Dividend Declaration for Class A & Preferred  Share
